message.content:
This editorial illustration features two men riding disparate vehicles against an off-white background with a vertical red band on the left. In the foreground, a man wearing a black helmet and grey jacket sits on a yellow motorcycle frame. The motorcycle is incomplete; parts like the engine, chain, and exhaust pipe are detached and floating behind it. Only the front wheel is attached.

Above and behind him, a man in a white shirt and black cap sits on a brown horse. The rear half of the horse is a skeletal structure of bones that is disintegrating into fragments. The man on the horse holds reins, while the man on the motorcycle holds handlebars.

Large red text at the bottom reads "KAMPANYE SETENGAH HATI". Below this, smaller black text describes legislative elections and mentions names like "JOKO WIDODO" and "PRABOWO SUBIANTO". The top of the page features the word "TEMPO" in large, faint grey letters, with headlines about "BAIQ NURIL" and "CUKAI ROKOK". A barcode and publication date "19-25 NOVEMBER 2018" are in the bottom right.
